regulator.name: Association of Professional Engineers and Geoscientists of Alberta

sources.title: Apply to APEGA as a Professional Member

pathways.name: Professional Member (P.Eng.)
pathways.summary: 48 months of acceptable engineering experience. Requires Canadian citizenship or permanent residence.

pathways.name: Licensee
pathways.summary: Same academic and experience requirements as a professional member, without the citizenship or permanent residence requirement.

pathways.name: Member-in-Training
pathways.summary: For applicants with fewer than 48 months of acceptable engineering experience.

requirements.title: Engineering degree
requirements.description: A degree from a program accredited by the Canadian Engineering Accreditation Board (CEAB), or one the Board of Examiners considers equivalent. Academic requirements must be complete before applying.

requirements.title: Exams assigned by the Board of Examiners
requirements.description: If the program is not accredited or equivalent, the Board of Examiners may assign exams (for example, the Fundamentals of Engineering exam) to confirm the level of education.

requirements.title: 48 months of engineering experience
requirements.description: 48 months of engineering work experience acceptable to the Board of Examiners. Applicants with less must apply as a member-in-training.

requirements.title: 22 key competencies
requirements.description: Experience is assessed against 22 key competencies in six categories, with minimum levels for the mandatory ones. For applications from July 18, 2026, eight Canadian work-environment equivalencies are integrated into the 22 competencies.

requirements.title: References and validators
requirements.description: Valid references and validators for the experience claimed.

requirements.title: National Professional Practice Exam (NPPE)
requirements.description: Must be passed before licensure. It can be written once a P.Eng. application is in progress; members-in-training write it only after applying for professional membership or licensure.

requirements.title: English competency
requirements.description: Competency in written and spoken English.

requirements.title: Canadian citizenship or permanent residence
requirements.description: Proof of Canadian citizenship or permanent resident status. Professional members only; licensees do not need it.

documents.name: WES Course-by-Course ICAP report
documents.description: World Education Services Course-by-Course International Credential Advantage Package, issued in English. WES is the only international credential service APEGA recognizes, and no other WES product is accepted. It must include all transcripts, including transfer credits.

documents.name: Degree transcripts
documents.description: Conferred undergraduate transcripts, plus postgraduate and transfer-credit transcripts if applicable, all evaluated within the WES report. APEGA does not accept transcripts sent by applicants.

documents.name: Advanced Placement transcripts
documents.description: If applicable, sent directly to APEGA by the issuing school, because WES does not evaluate AP courses.

fees.name: Application fee, registered in another Canadian province or territory

timelines.name: Complete all application steps and pay
Provide outstanding requirements after payment
timelines.description: Otherwise the application is withdrawn. This includes WES sending its report.

timelines.name: Introductory letter after a complete application
Review of a complete P.Eng. application
timelines.description: Up to 6 months from the date the application meets completeness requirements.

timelines.name: Board of Examiners decision
timelines.description: The Board meets monthly except July; the decision is emailed by the end of the month after the meeting.

competencies.name: Safety in Design and Technical Work
Promote Team Effectiveness and Resolve or Mitigate Interpersonal Conflict
Benefits of Engineering to the Public

open_questions: Minimum levels for the non-mandatory competencies are on APEGA's Competency Scoring page, which has not been captured yet.
Course-level matching (Phase 2) needs APEGA's discipline syllabi, which have not been captured yet. The WES report is the authoritative academic evaluation.
